# Course reference implementation

`dag_builder.py` is the unmodified CS5491 course handout for **Automated
Bootstrapping Placement**, obtained from Canvas in the 2026-09-24 source snapshot.
The instructor supplied the graphs, latency functions, fixed placements, scorer
and plotting helpers. They are reference material, not our optimisation method.

SHA-256: `47a63fd1698da64731f8b9e77067f3ef7e0889534c4e7659bb7fc113ce97acee`

- [Course project page](https://cityu-dg.instructure.com/courses/911/pages/course-project)
- [Topic handout](https://cityu-dg.instructure.com/courses/911/files/180071/download?download_frd=1)
- Code location: Canvas, Files / Project / Automated Bootstrapping Placement.

The source arrived without an explicit redistribution licence. Attribution is
preserved here; no additional licence is asserted for the instructor's code.
This local repository has not been published. Resolve redistribution permission
before publishing this file, or provide an approved acquisition mechanism.
The course PDF, archive and private source manifest are not bundled here.

The loader verifies these exact bytes. If a course update changes them, retain
the old run, review the new rules and perform a new calibration with a new run ID.
